description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

VHD(x) containers will be dynamically allocated. VHD(x) file size will grow as data is added to the VHD(x). If disabled, VHD(x) containers that are auto-created will be fully allocated.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IsDynamic
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
